title: North-West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions and Regulation of Health-Care Services Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions and Regulation of Health-Care Services Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2010
ACT VII OF 2010
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MEDICAL AND
HEALTH INSTITUTIONS AND REGULATION OF HEALTH-
CARE SERVICES (AMENDMFNT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province
Medical and Health Institutions
and Regulation of
Health-Care Services Ordinance,
2002
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary,
20th March, 2010]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Bills/2010/10577,
dated 20-3-2010.---The North-West Frontier Province
Medical and Health Institutions and Regulation of Health-Care Services
(Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on 12th March, 2010 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 16th March, 2010 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions and Regulation of
Health-Care Services Ordinance, 2002, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions and Regulation of
Health-Care Services (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the

It is hereby
enacted as follows:
3. Substitution
of section 26 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XLVII of 2002.---In the said Ordinance, for section 26, the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"26. Appeal.---Any employee of the institution aggrieved by an
order passed by the Management Council or Management Committee under section 11
or any person aggrieved by an order passed under section 25 may, within thirty
days of passing of the order, prefer an appeal to Government and the Government
shall within thirty days make decision on such appeal which shall be final:
Provided that an
employee of the institution may, within thirty days from the date of
communication of the order in appeal, submit a review petition to
Government".
